threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.

Management noted that the West Asia crisis has affected fuel costs, fuel availability, and aluminum pricing, requiring re-sourcing of aluminum.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Fuel availability was an issue. Fortunately, now it is only inflation that's an issue, not so much fuel cost. Aluminium, we were buying major quantities from the Middle East. So we had to re-source and also aluminium prices have gone up." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Management stated that the CBAM tax liability introduced in Europe on exports has been provided and booked under other expenses.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So one of our products which we export to Europe has a CBAM tax liability, which is provided and it is booked under other expenses." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

(concall transcript - 2026-05-01)
